entries.en: Back in sixty-two, when I was in Vegas, I saw a vermillion flycatcher.
entries.ro: În '62, când eram în Vegas, am văzut un vermillion flycatcher.

entries.en: Maybe, yeah. I mean, I was doing a lot of synthblow at the time...
entries.ro: Poate. Adică, trăgeam bine de synthblow pe atunci...

entries.en: Bull-fuckin'-shit. Flycatchers died out just like every other bird.
entries.ro: Căcat, pula mea. Flycatcherii au dispărut ca orice altă pasăre.
